about: Every frame of the fog-edge board as its own PNG at native size: <option>_<scene>.png are 1:1 crops (800 x 420) of the game's frames, the same pixels for every option; <scene> is open_z1.0 / open_z0.35 / forest_z1.0 / forest_z0.35 (the edge of the light fighter's 800 m sight circle across open ground and across forest) or los (the tank's line-of-sight shape in a valley, zoom 1.0: e0_los is today, eN_los_interp has viewshed.interp true); context_* are whole 1280 x 720 frames; palette_fog.png is the swatch row.
